dogecoin.text: @SinclairEuan Four months ago, I had an Uber driver ask me what I thought about Dogecoin. My advice aged poorly. These are the bubble moments.

@AlexSteffen @ShiraOvide @fmanjoo I mean asset prices are probably inflated through monetary policy right now. The amount of people who trade retail is completely ludicrous. I have Uber drivers asking me about #Dogecoin. More money has been pumped into global equity funds in the last 6 months than past 12 years.
